translations.web: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
translations.bsb: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
translations.kjv: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
translations.asv: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, To cast down the poor and needy, To slay such as are upright in the way.
